C0792.title: Keenadu Firmware Backdoor Infects Android Tablets via Signed OTA Updates
C0792.summary: In February 2026, Kaspersky disclosed Keenadu, an Android firmware-level backdoor. The malware can be distributed in device firmware, system apps, or apps from official stores, and some compromised firmware was delivered through OTA updates. Once active, it operates as a multi-stage loader that can remotely control devices and has been used for ad fraud, installation monetization, and data collection.
